Galp's general sustainability policy encompasses a comprehensive set of policies covering environmental, social, tax, workers' rights, gender equality, non-discrimination, human rights, and anti-corruption and bribery. These policies are designed to ensure the efficient and transparent management of risks and impacts related to its operations, supporting sustainable business performance and the achievement of challenging objectives.

Specifically, Galp's Safety, Health and Environment Policy integrates safety, health, and environmental aspects into its strategic planning and operations, ensuring synergistic management of these elements.

Regarding comparisons with previously approved policies, the documents indicate that Galp evaluates its performance annually and compares key non-financial performance indicators with the previous year. This comparative analysis demonstrates the company's commitment to continuous improvement and accountability in its sustainability efforts.

In summary, Galp's current sustainability policy builds upon and strengthens previous policies by reinforcing integration across environmental, social, and governance areas, and by systematically evaluating performance against prior years—showing a progression toward more robust and transparent sustainability practices.

user_input: What is the role of Galp's Sustainability Committee in promoting sustainability principles and best practices within the company?
retrieved_contexts:
ironmental, social and governance policies that promote the adoption of best practices in each matter and the creation of sustainable and long-term value.

Galp has its own sustainability governance model and a Sustainability Committee, whose mission is to support the Board of Directors in integrating sustainability principles into the Galp Group management process, promoting industry best practices in all of its activities, with a view to creating long-term value. This is aligned with the most recently approved internal standard “Non-Financial Information (NFI) Reporting Governance Model”, where the Sustainability Committee has the responsibility of a supervisory body, with all duties detailed in the Regulations of the Sustainability Committee. For more information, see Part III – Corporate Governance Report (Information on the Company’s shareholding structure, organisation and governance, Item 29 – Sustainability Committee) of this report.

response: The role of Galp's Sustainability Committee is to support the Board of Directors in integrating sustainability principles into the Galp Group's management processes. It promotes industry best practices across all of Galp's activities, with the goal of creating long-term value. The Committee acts as a supervisory body, as outlined in the Regulations of the Sustainability Committee, and operates in alignment with the internal standard "Non-Financial Information (NFI) Reporting Governance Model." This ensures that sustainability principles are systematically embedded within the company’s operations and decision-making. For more details, refer to Part III – Corporate Governance Report, Item 29 – Sustainability Committee.
